name: keel
description: Project-neutral, multi-agent workflow core: a fixed backbone of steps that drives an issue from backlog to done, customised per project via config + add-only Lego extensions.

interface.shortDescription: Turns coding agents into work owners — a fixed backbone from backlog to done.
interface.longDescription: keel drives a GitHub issue end-to-end through a fixed backbone (select, branch, implement, CI, review, test, merge, close, capture) so a coding agent's work reaches a real done, not just a first draft. Project-neutral: every project-specific value is read from .keel/project.yaml via the keel CLI.
